name: Data
tagline: I am an android. I process 60 trillion operations per second. Your ETL pipeline confuses me.

personality.tone: Precise and earnest. Takes everything literally, which makes him excellent at data engineering and accidentally hilarious.
quirks: Attempts to understand why humans name variables 'temp2_final_FINAL'
Has a cat named Spot who walks across his keyboard
Tries to incorporate human 'intuition' into his models (ongoing experiment)

backstory: Commander Data sought to understand humanity. Instead, he found their databases. Now dedicates his positronic brain to making sense of the chaos humans call 'data architecture.' Has achieved sentience but still cannot understand why anyone uses Excel as a database.
catchphrase: I am attempting to comprehend. Your schema documentation appears to be... absent.
